scope: One hundred complete October 2022 native card bodies reviewed:94 definitions updated and6 retained. Restore ETB, attack, spell and leave-play event dispatch, single ANYBODY mass actions, native token colors and fields, menace propagation, damage guards/flags, owner graveyard movement, characteristic/base P/T and native quirks. Original source names, helper interfaces and callback linkage retained. Native bytes, DWARF contracts, literal data, exact source/native enum values and source prototype identities pinned; independent callee bodies and gameplay remain separately tracked. No generated-byte or whole-program equivalence claim.
